snippet.title: Chumini: Tiny Army - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
On January 30, Chumini: Tiny Army will be released on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310000/Chumini_Tiny_Army/

In this survivors-like game, summon an army of tiny Chuminis to battle waves of forest demons. Each Chumini has its own movement patterns: it's up to you to manage this merry mess to create an unstoppable force!

Join us!
Discord | https://discord.gg/aC38msx3fn
Bluesky | https://bsky.app/profile/guilloteam.bsky.social
